clues.question: I cannot sign my note because my attending has *** areas that are not completed. And now I'm getting emails from FHC about closing my note! ​ ​ What should I do?​
clues.answer:
• Go into the encounter and click into the attending's note.  Find any *** area and delete it. ​
  • You should then be able to sign it. ​ 
  • If you get stuck, please reach out to your FTL or FHC med dir to troubleshoot.​ ​ ​ 
Also do this if a MEA or other care team member has any *** or drop-downs preventing you from signing your note.​

clues.question: How can you tell whether an eReferral was accepted by the consultant, (i.e. the patient will be scheduled for appt)?​
clues.answer:
• Accept means will schedule -> click ‘Close E-Consult’​ (Top Image)
  • None usually means they gave some counseling and/or wanted other steps completed before scheduling. (Bottom Image)

clues.question: I have so many CC chart messages. What do I do with them?​
clues.answer:
•  If it’s an FYI and there are no to-dos, click ‘Done’​
  • If there are specific action items, either do it in the moment or create a ‘remind me’ to do later.  ​
  • If pt has upcoming appt soon, could copy and paste into yellow sticky note as your chart prep. ​ ​ ​
 Ultimately, the goal is to click ‘Done’. ​

clues.question:
• What are the guidelines for your Patient Case Conference (PCC) Presentation? ​ 
  • How do you know when your PCC (R3s) / EBM (R2s) presentation is scheduled for?
clues.answer:
Present ONE patient care conference per year:​ ​ 
  1. Select a patient​ 
  2. Choose an area of focus​ 
  3. Create your presentation (format you prefer – ppt, white board, M&M)​ 
  4. Discuss your conference and review your presentation plan with Simone Vais​ 
  5. Send a copy of your final presentation to Elizabeth Deely
See your schedule on Qgenda​ ​ ​ 

For EBM, you will receive an email from Christine Dehlendorf ​

clues.question: Name a best practice for finishing notes on time? ​
clues.answer:
• Type a rough HPI while the patient is talking (or type in see A/P)​ 
  • Type up PE immediately after visit (or use macros)​ 
  • Place all orders before end of visit​ Use .diagpocord for your A/P to avoid toggling within each problem  ​ 
  • If running on time or early, take a few minutes after visit to finish your note​ 
  • Sign your encounter within 72 hours of clinic encounter​
